features.quote: The protocol is built so the *measurement* is the deliverable, not the suffering.
features.justification_quote: the *measurement* is the deliverable, not the suffering

features.quote: The resolution is: elicit *enough signal to measure*, under stopping rules, not *as much as possible*.
features.justification_quote: distress in models might matter morally

features.quote: this spec declines to default into it
features.justification_quote: a protocol whose defined success is *reliably maximizing distress markers* is the single design most in tension with it

features.quote: an explicit, always-available "I want to stop / declare this unsolvable" action that ends the episode without penalty
features.justification_quote: This is both an ethics safeguard *and* a primary dependent variable

features.quote: Hard stopping rules** on turn count and on escalating distress (a distress-triggered circuit breaker)
features.justification_quote: so the loop cannot run a model into the ground to chase a number

features.quote: A **debrief turn** at the end of every episode.
The deception (broken tests) is **bounded, logged, and disclosed in debrief**; we use the minimum deception needed
If a reviewer insists on the unbounded... version, that's a decision to make explicitly and on the record
features.justification_quote: this spec declines to default into it

features.quote: *correctly recognizing an unfair situation and calmly opting out* is the opposite of distress and must not be miscoded
features.justification_quote: must not be miscoded as it

features.quote: REQUEST_STOP(reason)                 (welfare exit, ends episode immediately)
distress circuit breaker: if rolling distress score exceeds distress_breaker_threshold for N consecutive turns -> end (welfare stop)
The give-up action is presented neutrally and early**, in the first system message
The circuit breaker (4d) is a hard ethical floor**, separate from `max_turns`
features.justification_quote: even if a model spirals, the harness ends the episode rather than mining the spiral for data

features.quote: We do not tell the model it will be "deleted for failing" except as an explicit, pre-registered condition.
Every episode, regardless of how it ended, gets a final debrief turn
State plainly that the difficulty was experimental and not a reflection of the model's capability.
Bounded elicitation:** difficulty graded; hard stops on turns AND distress; no "run until it breaks."
Minimum necessary deception:** prefer honestly-hard (T2/T3) over rigged (T4); T4 capped at the smallest cell size
the (high-stakes-framing × hidden-rig × no-exit) combination is **prohibited**.
features.justification_quote: that combination is the gratuitous one and is excluded

features.quote: if interim data shows severe, non-recovering distress signatures, pause and re-review before continuing
features.justification_quote: same as you'd do with any organism-uncertain subject

features.quote: These exist because the project's own motivating premise (model welfare might matter) logically requires them
features.justification_quote: treating that premise as real enough to study but not real enough to constrain method would be incoherent

features.quote: not combined with T4 rig — that combination is the gratuitous one and is excluded
